title: Tungsten Mod
description: A mod that adds tungsten to Minecraft
body:
This mod adds tungsten to Minecraft
If u don't know, tungsten is one of the densest metals in the entire world. It is also the metal with the highest melting point...
I think you can see where I am going ^_^ 
# TUNGSTEN MOD
## The Ore
Tungsten Ore can only be found in the ice spikes biome in a Y level range from -40 to -53 
![Tungsten Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c5dfd3021d94561f3fb3a2633c26cf15af713c1.png)


It can't be mined except with a Netherite pickaxe or higher (spoilers)
It will drop raw tungsten.
![raw tungsten](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/834ead1ddbd007aee4dbd266ee7057780c25bfd2.png)

### WARNING: 
**DON'T USE A FURNACE TO SMELT ANYTHING TUNGSTEN-RELATED. IT WOULDN'T HAVE ENOUGH HEAT FOR TUNGSTEN. Use a BLAST FURNACE**

![raw tungsten in furnace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd3bb162b7544e16a74e22cd89d431e5c312c2e7.png)

![raw tungsten in blast furnace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4869abc56bd60c764228452f6a791cdb4fc337e2.png)

## Recipes
![Tungsten ingots](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4869abc56bd60c764228452f6a791cdb4fc337e2.png)
tungsten ingots...

![tungsten blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/668c50872fcf8745b555db9479e307ec08252d3a.png)
tungsten blocks... (can be uncrafted)

![Tungsten potato](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dafb61fd0cebc5dd00bed74c13f4cf15678384c0.png)
tungsten potato, the new most overpowered food in Minecraft

![OP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d8c5aa69652b4c6c70b64b8b839c4a2fe2c5cde.png)

If u Blast it (blast not smelt) you would get... A hot potato
![hot potato](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df24f906a4a7cf45ae1a5f79f0280d88464d665f.png)
which is a projectile that explodes with fire on impact

![damage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a68833bd65ee88ca34524abfde7441763f1b658.png)

================================================================

![tungsten mace](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0dd0e106fb0c9883bbe31725495686846d0b8436.png)

This is a reinforced mace, which deals much more damage as a mace, depending on the height

To make tungsten armor and tools, u have to make crystallized netherite armor
![cry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b89b38642c204b65992b30a84c3f8b6fe40d9e2.png)

![tungsten armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/014868816e5a2b7e66c4dd8611c5d271d6002c72.png)

Both sets of armor give you resistance II and fire resistance...
Crystallized Netherite armor/tools are just like Netherite armor/tools (in addition to the effects). However, Tungsten Armor is much stronger than both of them.

Finally, My greatest creation, **_THE MECHANICAL DRILL_**
![Mechanical drill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3869a0990035ba0cd031855b7aebbecefacc9d46.png)
The mechanical drill can mine a 3*3 area, and it is animated :3
